description: Fix orchestrator frontmatter drift (Write in disallowedTools contradicts body) and mark frontmatter advisory-only in both copies, then re-embed.

userStories.title: Align orchestrator Write grant and mark frontmatter advisory-only
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need the orchestrator prompt template to grant Write (matching the .claude/ copy and the body's self-handoff requirement) and both copies to state that the frontmatter is advisory-only, so a downstream model is not induced to self-restrict and kill the self-handoff (exit 3 loop).
acceptanceCriteria: templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md lists Write under `tools:` and does NOT list Write under `disallowedTools:`, matching the .claude/ copy and the body's requirement to Write the self-handoff file. [oracle: file-assert: awk-extract frontmatter shows Write in tools list and absent from disallowedTools in templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md]

Orchestrator WebFetch is RETAINED under `tools:` in the template (not cut), because grill-with-docs uses it to fetch official docs during spec interviews. [oracle: grep -q 'WebFetch' templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md]

Both orchestrator prompt copies contain an explicit statement that the frontmatter tools/disallowedTools are advisory-only because the orchestrator is spawned without --agent (run.ts:255, setup.ts:443/520), with a pointer that CAM-240 tracks making it binding. [oracle: file-assert: grep -q 'advisory' templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md && grep -q 'advisory' .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md && grep -q 'CAM-240' templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md && grep -q 'CAM-240' .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md]
vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts still passes for the .claude/ copies (exit 0). [oracle: bun vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts]
Vendor drift check passes after re-embed (bun run embed-vendor applied). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (move Write from disallowedTools to tools), .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (already grants Write; add only the advisory note), and src/vendor/_generated.ts via `bun run embed-vendor` (do NOT hand-edit the generated file). GOTCHA (memory: cam-dual-copy-is-per-file): the two copies are per-file and NOT byte-identical (the .claude/ copy already has Write in tools and omits it from disallowedTools; the template does the opposite). Diff both before re-embedding; only the template's tools/disallowedTools lines change, plus the new advisory note added to BOTH. GOTCHA: do NOT cut WebFetch (the tool-matrix audit wrongly claimed it unused; grill-with-docs fetches docs via WebFetch). Do NOT implement --agent runtime enforcement here (out of scope, CAM-240). Advisory note placement: near the frontmatter or Identity section; body self-handoff requirement is at template line ~436 ('Write the handoff first'). embed-vendor:check is a REQUIRED gate because templates/ is touched. Blocked-by CAM-225 is already shipped.
